serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
After a few hours of work Annalie told me to go home.
She also insisted on giving me something to eat since shops nearby are all wrecked too.
I was pretty concerned about her health and because of my nagging she agreed to take a break and go to sleep.
Thanks to her hard work she’s almost ready to open the shop.
If I was as motivated as her in college I wouldn't be a dropout for sure…
